title: They bought this Laguna Beach home for $16 million and spent $20 million rebuilding it. It is now listed for $112 million
summary_full: A Laguna Beach oceanfront estate is now on the market for $112 million.  The owners invested $20 million to extensively renovate the property over two years.  This remarkable residence spans 14,400 square feet and includes six bedrooms.  The owners are selling as they have relocated and no longer need the large home.  This listing aims to set a new residential sales record for Orange County.
